props.text: ONE POSSIBLE JOURNEY · TIME AND SCALE COMPRESSED
A journey through water, weather and the spaces between.
Water becomes invisible vapor. Sunlight supplies the energy.
As moist air cools, vapor can condense into tiny liquid droplets.
Rain returns water to the land. Its next path is still unwritten.
Some water enters soil, moving through pores and cracks.
Rivers and groundwater meet the sea. The cycle has many routes.
THESE JOURNEYS TAKE DIFFERENT AMOUNTS OF TIME.
